sound_effects.whoosh_fast: Swish transition sound for rapid card slides and text entrances.
sound_effects.synth_thump: Low sub-bass impact for hook reveals and alert cards.
sound_effects.riser_tension: Pitch-ascending riser building tension during problem state.
sound_effects.chime_success: Crisp high-frequency chime for product reveal and solution state.
sound_effects.ui_click_soft: Soft tactile click for button presses and counter reveals.
sound_effects.notification_alert: Subtle bell alert for rate cut warnings.

mixing_rules.voiceover_ducking: Background music ducked -12dB under voiceover narration.
mixing_rules.sfx_peak_level: Sound effects mixed at -6dB peak relative to voiceover.
mixing_rules.master_loudness: Target -14 LUFS integrated for short-form video platforms.
